description: This file defines the XStringFormat class within the PdfSharp.Drawing namespace, which encapsulates text layout settings such as alignment and line alignment. It includes properties for horizontal and vertical text alignment, as well as some obsolete static properties for common formats. The class is intended for managing text formatting in PDF drawing operations, with conditional code for GDI integration.

classes.description: Represents the text layout formatting options such as alignment and line alignment for text rendering in PDFs within the PdfSharp library.
